All-on-X is a fixed, full-arch dental implant treatment. A custom bridge of replacement teeth attaches to a number of implants, often four to six, chosen for your jaw. At Noble Dental Care in Union City, Dr. Syed Z. Sayeedi plans each case with 3D imaging for patients from Hayward and across the East Bay.
